budget.rationale: The independently itemized $12,850–$16,750 family planning band has a credible high case above the $15,000 strongly preferred maximum, which maps to 1/5 under the shared budget rubric; it remains visible, not excluded.

weather.rationale: Official Algarve guidance plus historical Sicily means support a mostly comfortable, heat-aware June range, but the full route lacks a stored reproducible extract; the 4/5 judgment remains medium-confidence.

fireRisk.rationale: Moderate is the safety rating (3/5), corresponding to a 5–10% planning chance of material wildfire disruption during the exact trip window. The route's most exposed profiles are The Algarve in June and Sicily in June. Portugal is one of Europe's highest absolute fire-danger countries and the official summer campaign begins June 1. Coastal Lagos is less exposed than the wooded interior, but Monchique, Sagres, and east–west road excursions add enough wildland interface that fire belongs in the plan. Sicily is highly fire-prone and the July 2026 island-wide emergency confirms that the consequence can be severe. Timing matters: the regional 2023 analysis found no critical fire conditions from early summer through mid-July before a sharp late-July surge. June is meaningfully safer than July, but not low-risk.

swim.rationale: Official Algarve guidance supports cool Atlantic water (~66–70°F) followed by warmer Sicily swimming (~72–75°F), but the full route range lacks a stored site-level SST extract; confidence remains medium.

variety.rationale: The canonical plan schedules water/coast, towns/food, and nature/volcano across the Algarve and Sicily, but dropping the Lisbon/Sintra city-and-palace dimension narrows the mix to a coast-plus-Sicily story, holding Variety at 4/5.

ease.rationale: Three bases, two base moves, and one apartment per region — with a single Vueling Barcelona connection replacing the retired four-base Cascais opener and its Carvoeiro-to-Lisbon backtrack — is a moderate 3/5; two rental cars and one internal connecting flight keep it from higher. Ticket uncertainty is scored only under Risk.

food.rationale: Current first-party store pages independently document grocery/plain-food fallback coverage in Lagoa for Carvoeiro, Cefalu, and Giardini Naxos for the Taormina-coast base, alongside named pizza/pasta restaurants at each base. That supports Food 5/5; store hours and stock still need a pre-trip recheck.

risk.rationale: Removing the Carvoeiro-to-Lisbon same-day backtrack and the twice-weekly self-transfer, and routing the internal hop as a single Vueling Barcelona connection, cuts the worst failure mode to a moderate 3/5; the exact 2027 schedule and the single-through-ticket status remain unverified, which is why it is not higher.

nights.rationale: Twelve hotel nights derives 5/5 under the canonical nights rubric.

novelty.rationale: Algarve, Cefalù, Etna and Taormina are new within the documented visited-place overlap rubric.

pto.rationale: Eight PTO days derives 3/5 and remains unweighted by default.
